notes:
**Import MIDI** - bring a .mid file's notes into the piano roll. Notes come in flat (pitch bend isn't read from the file).

**Per-section wave shaping** - Shift-click one bend point, then Shift-click another on the same note, to ride a sine or triangle wave on just that section instead of the whole note. Shift-click either point again to cancel.

**Multi-select shape shortcuts** - with more than one note selected, press 1 (straight), 2 (triangle), or 3 (sine) to set all of them at once.

**Thinner notes** - note ribbons are drawn thinner and have a smaller click area, so it's easier to grab a note next to another one at a neighboring pitch without misclicking.

**New waves default to 0.00 -> 0.25 amplitude** (was 0.50).

**Fixed: notes stuck sounding forever after the loop restarts.** A note ending exactly on the loop boundary could get skipped by both halves of the loop-wrap logic and never receive its note-off. Fixed.

**Fresh instances now open with an empty piano roll** (no more demo notes).
